title: 第21章 六重的声音
novel_title: 全民武道：女配小弟他无敌了！
content_zh:
药池第二批开放，月初第一天。

    安槐排在第一个进入A区的一号池。

    这次没有带苏念念，她的排名够用B级就够了，而且A级药池的药力太猛，四重修为的人进去反而容易经脉受损。

    一号池的药水颜色比上次深了许多，近乎靛蓝，表面的热气像薄雾一样弥漫，安槐换好浸泡服踏入池中的瞬间，一股灼热的药力从脚底直冲天灵盖。

    他闭上眼，开始按照固元淬体诀的路径引导药力。

    这半个月他每天晚上用两个小时修炼新功法，配合系统兑换的经脉优化方案，五重的壁垒已经松动到了临界点。

    今天，他要破。

    药力沿着经脉涌入四肢百骸，每经过一处穴位就像有人用烙铁在皮肤下面划过，安槐的表情纹丝不动，额角渗出细密的汗珠。

    【修炼状态监测：淬体五重进度98%。突破条件已满足，经脉韧性达标，灵气储量充足，宿主，你可以开始冲击了。】

    安槐深吸一口气，全身的灵气开始以一种极快的速度运转。

    固元淬体诀的第六式，也是突破的关键式，灵气从丹田出发，走一条极窄极险的路线，穿过脊椎两侧的十二个微型穴位，在百会穴汇聚后反冲回丹田。

    就像把一根线穿过十二个针眼，一个都不能偏。

    安槐的意识高度集中，灵气在体内奔涌，每经过一个穴位都发出一声极其细微的“嗡”响。

    第一个，通了。

    第二个，通了。

    第七个的时候，灵气在穴位入口处卡了一下，安槐的眉头微微皱起，右手在水下握紧了拳头。

    别急，上辈子做实验的时候他学过一件事，越是关键步骤越不能慌。

    他微调了灵气的角度，不是硬冲，而是用一种旋转的方式绕了进去。

    通了。

    第八个、第九个、第十个、第十一个。

    第十二个穴位的阻力比前面所有的加起来还大，安槐感觉自己的经脉像一根被拉到极限的橡皮筋，再多一分力就要崩断。

    【警告：经脉承受力接近上限。建议缓冲三秒后再发力。】

    安槐没有缓冲。

    他在灵气冲击第十二个穴位的同时，把体内残余的所有力量压缩成一个点，跟在灵气后面推了一把。

    轰。

    不是声音，是感觉。

    全身经脉像是同时被冲洗了一遍，从里到外焕然一新，一股从未有过的力量从丹田涌出来，沿着崭新的经脉路线在体内完成了一个完整的循环。

    淬体六重。

    安槐缓缓睁开眼睛。

    池水的颜色变淡了一层，大量的药力已经被他的身体吸收殆尽，他抬起手，手指微微握了握，能清晰地感觉到力量比之前提升了一个档次。

    不是简单的量变，是质变。

    六重之后，灵气的运转效率提高了将近一倍，感知范围也扩大了至少三成。

    【恭喜宿主突破淬体六重。奖励：系统积分200点。评价：中规中矩，没有翻车，没有惊喜，你这个人突破跟做数学题一样，步骤工整，结果正确，毫无观赏性。】

    “突破又不是表演。”

    【你就不能给我一点素材吗？比如突破的时候喊一嗓子，或者爆出一道金光什么的，你这样安安静静地，我连解说词都编不出来。】

    “那你就说，宿主在安静中完成了突破，一如既往地不给系统面子。”

    【你真的很欠揍，你知道吗？】

    安槐嘴角弯了弯，从药池里站起来。
content_en:
The second batch of medicinal pools will be opened on the first day of the month.

An Huai was the first to enter Pool No. 1 in Area A.

I didn't take Su Niannian with me this time. Her ranking was B-level. Moreover, the A-level medicinal pool was too powerful, and people with fourth-level cultivation would easily suffer damage to their meridians if they entered it.

The color of the potion in Pool No. 1 was much darker than last time, almost indigo, and the heat on the surface spread like mist. The moment An Huai changed into his soaking suit and stepped into the pool, a scorching potion rushed from the soles of his feet to the sky.

He closed his eyes and began to guide the power of the medicine according to the path of the Gu Yuan Body Tempering Technique.

In the past half month, he spent two hours every night practicing new techniques. In conjunction with the system's meridians optimization plan, the fifth level barrier has been loosened to the critical point.

Today, he is going to break.

The power of the medicine poured into the limbs and bones along the meridians. Every time it passed through an acupuncture point, it was like someone was drawing a hot iron under the skin. An Huai's expression remained motionless, and fine beads of sweat oozed from his forehead.

[Monitoring of training status: The progress of the fifth level of body tempering is 98%.The conditions for breakthrough have been met, the toughness of the meridians has reached the standard, and the spiritual energy reserves are sufficient. Host, you can start the attack.】

An Huai took a deep breath, and the spiritual energy in his body began to circulate at an extremely fast speed.

The sixth form of the Guyuan Body Tempering Technique is also the key to breakthrough. The spiritual energy starts from the Dantian, takes a very narrow and dangerous route, passes through twelve micro-acupoints on both sides of the spine, gathers at the Baihui point, and then rushes back to the Dantian.

Just like passing a thread through twelve needle eyes, none of them can be missed.

An Huai's consciousness was highly concentrated, and spiritual energy surged through his body, making an extremely subtle "buzz" sound every time it passed through an acupuncture point.

The first one, passed.

The second one passed.

On the seventh time, the spiritual energy got stuck at the entrance of the acupuncture point. An Huai frowned slightly and clenched his right hand into a fist under the water.

Don't worry, he learned one thing when doing experiments in his previous life: the more critical the step, the less panicked it is.

He fine-tuned the angle of the spiritual energy, instead of rushing in forcefully, he used a rotating method to go around it.

Got it.

The eighth, ninth, tenth, eleventh.

The resistance at the twelfth acupoint was greater than all the previous ones combined. An Huai felt that his meridians were like a rubber band stretched to the limit, and it would break if it exerted more force.

[Warning: The endurance of the meridians is close to the upper limit.It is recommended to buffer for three seconds before exerting force.】

Anhuai has no buffer.

While the spiritual energy hit the twelfth acupuncture point, he compressed all the remaining power in his body into a point, and pushed after the spiritual energy.

boom.

It’s not the sound, it’s the feeling.

The meridians all over the body seemed to have been flushed at the same time, and they were brand new from the inside out. An unprecedented power surged out from the Dantian, completing a complete cycle in the body along the new meridians.

The sixth level of body tempering.

An Huai slowly opened his eyes.

The color of the pool water became a layer lighter, and a large amount of the medicinal power had been absorbed by his body. He raised his hand and clenched it slightly with his fingers. He could clearly feel that his strength had improved to a higher level than before.

It is not a simple quantitative change, but a qualitative change.

After the sixth level, the operating efficiency of spiritual energy has nearly doubled, and the range of perception has been expanded by at least 30%.

[Congratulations to the host for breaking through to the sixth level of body tempering.Reward: 200 system points.Evaluation: It's quite satisfactory, no overturns, no surprises. Your breakthrough is like doing a math problem, the steps are neat, the results are correct, and it's not entertaining at all.】

"A breakthrough is not a performance."

[Can’t you give me some material?For example, you shout when you break through, or burst out with a golden light or something. If you do it so quietly, I can't even make up a commentary.】

"Then you say that the host completed the breakthrough quietly and, as always, did not give the system face."

[You really deserve a beating, do you know that?】

An Huai curved the corners of his mouth and stood up from the medicine pool.
title_en: Chapter 21 The Sixth Level of Voice
